features.title: Apply table structure and persistence operations
features.description: Extend EditorBlock.TableBlock with backward-compatible fitToWidth serialization and implement insert, clear, delete, duplicate, and fit-to-width transformations in NoteEditorViewModel. Remove the entire block when deleting its final row or column, deep-copy duplicates, guard read-only state, and reuse auto-save.
features.user_visible_behavior: Table commands produce the specified updated document immediately and persist through the existing editor save path.

features.title: Reveal focused table handles and option sheets
features.description: Add focus-driven column, row, and table-options handles to TableDocumentBlock, retain the target while a sheet is open, render the approved Material 3 sheets with Delete last, and expose localized labels, content descriptions, and stable test tags. Read-only notes show no handles.
features.user_visible_behavior: Tapping an editable cell reveals three handles; each handle opens its corresponding options sheet in the approved order, and tapping away dismisses the handles.
